rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a Day 5 3AB blastocyst: good ICM, looser B-grade TE, visible blastocoel and thinning zona. Minor overinterpretation of exact stage (3-4) and focal-plane details prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, diagnosis, BMI/lifestyle, endometrium, and male-factor context with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo grade and favorable patient factors. Minor cautionary emphasis on 14 mm lining and hidden male-factor issues is somewhat speculative.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including support for single embryo transfer and not routinely recommending PGT-A at age 25. Slight overemphasis on thick endometrium concern and some nonessential speculative testing keep it from a 5.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, SET, and contingency planning if unsuccessful. Useful and specific, though some recommendations remain broad rather than protocol-level.
